2609.40034.title: Efficient Active Auditing of Multi-Group Fairness with Bias Probes
2609.40034.paper_summary: Over the past decade, Machine Learning (ML) has been trained under dual objectives: minimizing prediction error via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) while controlling unfairness bias. In practice, however, fairness-aware training often yields limited improvements over standard ERM, making reliable post hoc auditing essential. Existing auditing approaches for black-box models either rely on model reconstruction --exposing systems to extraction attacks-- or directly estimate fairness metrics, offering limited insight into which regions of the data distribution drive bias. More fundamentally, property-specific auditing --aimed at extracting only targeted fairness information without reconstructing the model-- remains poorly understood. In this work, we introduce the bias probe framework, which enables targeted and adaptive querying to reveal bias structure while preserving model confidentiality. Building on this framework, we propose ALeBi, an active auditor that learns such probes to efficiently estimate multi-group fairness metrics. We establish novel sample complexity guarantees governed by a property-specific complexity measure, resolving a previously posed open question, and extend our analysis to adversarial settings where the model owner may strategically obscure bias. Our results uncover a fundamental trade-off between model confidentiality and reliable auditing, and show that property-specific probing enables both accurate estimation and interpretable identification of high and low-bias regions. Extensive experiments support our theoretical findings and demonstrate the practical effectiveness of our approach.
2609.40034.paper_summary_zh: 在過去十年中，機器學習（ML）在雙重目標下進行訓練：通過經驗風險最小化（ERM）來最小化預測誤差，同時控制不公平偏見。然而，在實踐中，考慮公平性的訓練通常對標準ERM的改進有限，使得可靠的事後審計變得至關重要。現有的黑箱模型審計方法要麼依賴於模型重建——使系統暴露於提取攻擊中——要麼直接估計公平性指標，對於驅動偏見的數據分佈區域提供有限的洞察。更根本的是，針對特定屬性的審計——旨在提取僅限於目標公平性信息而不重建模型——仍然理解不足。在本研究中，我們介紹了偏見探測框架，該框架使得有針對性和自適應的查詢成為可能，以揭示偏見結構，同時保持模型的機密性。在此框架的基礎上，我們提出了ALeBi，一個主動審計者，能夠學習這些探針以有效估計多組公平性指標。我們建立了由特定屬性複雜性度量所主導的新樣本複雜性保證，解決了一個先前提出的開放問題，並將我們的分析擴展到對抗性環境，其中模型擁有者可能會戰略性地掩蓋偏見。我們的結果揭示了模型機密性與可靠審計之間的基本權衡，並顯示針對特定屬性的探測能夠實現準確估計和可解釋的高低偏見區域識別。大量實驗支持我們的理論發現，並展示了我們方法的實際有效性。
